headline: My time is running out. Is my energy blocking my money?
note: Wired 2026-08-25 from fb-tarot/docs/writeups/shadow/REVIEW-money-alone-commit-2026-08-25.md — approved copy, transferred verbatim. Reuses the existing MONEY_TAROT_HOOKS frame; no new guard.

a: You turned the Magician. You couldn't see the cards, but your hand found the one who came ready.
Look at his table. A cup, a coin, a blade and a wand are all laid out.
You asked whether your energy is blocking your money as time runs short. What catches me is the complete table.
And yet the money is blocked, and time is the fear in your question.
Something sits between all that readiness and the money. I don't think it began with you.
Let me look closer at what that obstruction is…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. The picture was hidden, and your hand still went to the one held by a single thing.
One rope circles one ankle. The rest of him hangs free.
You asked whether your energy is the block. This card makes me look at that single rope.
Still, the money has not reached you. You are asking whether your energy is holding it.
Whatever has hold of the result holds it quietly. I don't think this began with you.
Let me see what's holding the result…
c: You turned the Fool. Nothing showed you which was which, yet you chose the one travelling light.
Look at the small bundle on his stick. That is all he is carrying.
You asked whether your energy blocks the money. What catches me is how little he carries.
But the money is blocked, and you feel time running out.
Something meets the money just where movement should begin. I don't think it started with you.
Now let me look at what's behind this…
